not_found.name: Unknown
description: Unable to find the requested blessing.

air.name: Air
description: ::ab[Zephyr's Gift (minor)]{icon=boost-def flavor="You can touch any one ranged weapon and enhance it with the quality of air." l1="For 1 minute, any attacks made with the weapon take no penalties due to range. In addition, making a ranged attack with this weapon doesn't provoke an attack of opportunity."}

::ab[Soaring Assault (major)]{icon=power-boost flavor="You can touch an ally and give her the gift of flight for 1 minute (as ‹spell/fly›)." l10="The ally gains a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability. She gains a bonus on Fly skill checks equal to your level. Whenever the ally succeeds at a ‹rule/charge› attack while flying, that attack deals an amount of additional electricity damage equal to your level."}

animal.name: Animal
description: ::ab[Animal Fury (minor)]{icon=melee flavor="You can touch one ally and grant it feral features." l1="The ally gains 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d6 points of damage if the ally is Medium or 1d4 if it's Small, or 1 bite attack that deals 1d8 points of damage if the ally is Medium or 1d6 if it's Small. These are primary ‹umr/natural attacks› that replace any similar primary natural attacks the ally might have. This effect lasts for 1 minute."}

::ab[Battle Companion (major)]{icon=magic flavor="You can summon a battle companion." l10="This ability functions as ‹spell/summon nature's ally V› with a duration of 1 minute. This ability can summon only one animal, regardless of the list used." incrementRoman="This now behaves as ‹spell/summon nature's~10~2~6" incrementDesc=ally incrementEnd="›." incrementMax=18}

artifice.name: Artifice
description: ::ab[Crafter's Wrath (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can touch one melee weapon and grant it greater power to harm and destroy crafted objects." l1="For 1 minute, whenever this weapon deals damage to constructs or objects, it bypasses hardness and damage reduction."}

::ab[Transfer Magic (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can temporarily transfer a weapon special ability from one weapon to another. The bearers of each of the weapons must be willing, and you must be touching both weapons to activate this ability.~~~You can transfer a weapon special ability with a base price modifier of +1 or +2. If you are using this ability on a ‹misc/double› weapon, only one end of the double weapon is affected. The transfer lasts for 1 minute, after which the transferred weapon special ability automatically returns to the source weapon.~~~You can use this ability multiple times on the same weapon or weapons. Alternatively, you can use *transfer magic* to move a +1 or +2 armor special ability from one touched suit of armor to another, or move a +1 or +2 armor or weapon enhancement bonus to another armor or weapon."}

chaos.name: Chaos
description: ::ab[Anarchic Strike (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can touch one weapon and grant it a chaotic blessing." l1="For 1 minute, the touched weapon glows yellow or purple and deals an additional 1d6 points of damage against lawful creatures. During this time, it's treated as chaotic for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction." special="This blessing's additional damage doesn't stack with the additional damage from the ‹magic-enh/anarchic› weapon special ability."}

::ab[Battle Companion (major)]{icon=magic flavor="You can summon a battle companion." l10="This ability functions as ‹spell/summon monster IV› with a duration of 1 minute, but for only a chaotic outsider or an animal with the ‹template/entropic› creature simple template. This ability can summon only one creature, regardless of the list used." incrementRoman="This now behaves as ‹spell/summon~10~2~5" incrementDesc=monster incrementEnd="›."}

charm.name: Charm
description: ::ab[Charming Presence (minor)]{icon=def flavor="You can touch an ally and grant an entrancing blessing." l1="For 1 minute, the ally becomes mesmerizing to her opponents, filling them with either abject admiration or paralyzing fear. This effect functions as ‹spell/sanctuary›, except if the ally attacks an opponent, the effect ends with respect to only that opponent. This is a mind-affecting effect."}

::ab[Dominance Aura (major)]{icon=aura-magic l10="You can surround yourself with a tangible aura of majesty for 1 minute. While this aura is active, once per round as a @HLswift_action you can issue a command (as the ‹spell/command› spell) to one creature within 30 feet; the creature must succeed at a Will saving throw or submit for 1 round."}

community.name: Community
description: ::ab[Communal Aid (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can touch an ally and grant it the blessing of community." l1="For the next minute, whenever that ally uses the ‹rule/aid another<_2› action, the bonus granted increases to +4. You can instead use this ability on yourself as a swift action."}

::ab[Fight as One (major)]{icon=boost flavor="You can rally your allies to fight together." l10="For 1 minute, whenever you make a successful melee or ranged attack against a foe, allies within 10 feet of you gain a +2 insight bonus on attacks of the same type you made against that foe - melee attacks if you made a melee attack, or ranged attacks if you made a ranged attack." special="If you score a critical hit, this bonus increases to +4 until the start of your next turn."}
@HL[ReplacementBlessing:] The following minor blessing replaces the *communal aid* ability of the Community blessing.

::ab[Team Effort (minor)]{icon=power flavor="You can touch an ally and grant it the blessing of cooperation." l1="Choose one ‹main/teamwork feat› that you have. The touched ally gains the benefit of the chosen teamwork feat for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your warpriest level (minimum 1). Alternatively, you can choose one teamwork feat that a touched ally has and gain the benefit of the chosen feat for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your warpriest level (minimum 1)."}

curse.name: Curse
description: ::ab[Hexing Attack (minor)]{icon=lower l1="You can touch one weapon and enhance it to inflict a minor curse on the next target it strikes. The struck target must succeed at a Will saving throw or take a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, or ability checks (warpriest's choice) for 1 minute."}

::ab[Retributive Curse (major)]{icon=lower l10="As a @HLswift or @HLimmediate_action, you can inflict a curse on any adjacent creature that scores a critical hit against you or deals ‹misc/precision damage› to you. The target must succeed at a Will saving throw or be cursed.~~~Select one of the following effects: the target takes a -2 penalty to one ability score of your choice (the ability cannot be reduced below 1); the target takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, and skill checks; each turn, the target has a 25% chance of taking no action (otherwise, it acts normally).~~~This curse lasts for 1 hour. A creature can be subjected to only one instance of *retributive curse* at a time. This otherwise functions as ‹spell/bestow curse›."}

darkness.name: Darkness
description: ::ab[Enshrouding Darkness (minor)]{icon=def flavor="You can touch an ally and bestow a darkness blessing." l1="For 1 minute, the ally becomes enshrouded in shadows while in combat, granting it ‹rule/concealment› (20%). Creatures that are normally able to see in supernatural darkness ignore this concealment."}

::ab[Darkened Vision (major)]{icon=lower l10="You can place a shroud of darkness around the eyes of one foe within 30 feet. The target must succeed at a Will saving throw or be ‹misc/blinded› for 1 minute (as ‹spell/blindness/deafness›)."}

death.name: Death
description: ::ab[From the Grave (minor)]{icon=boost-def flavor="You can take on a corpse-like visage for 1 minute, making you more intimidating and giving you undead-like protection from harm." l1="You gain a +4 bonus on Disguise checks to resemble an undead creature and on Intimidate checks, as well as a +2 profane bonus on saving throws against disease, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, and stun."}

::ab[Death's Touch (major)]{icon=lower l10="You can make a melee touch attack against an opponent to deliver grim suffering. If you succeed, you inflict 1 temporary ‹rule/negative level› on the target for 1 minute. Alternatively, you can activate this ability as a @HLswift_action upon hitting an opponent with a melee attack." special="These temporary negative levels stack. You gain no benefit from imposing these negative levels (such as the temporary hit points undead gain from ‹spell/enervation›)."}

destruction.name: Destruction
description: ::ab[Destructive Attacks (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can touch an ally and bless it with the power of destruction." l1="For 1 minute, the ally gains a morale bonus on weapon damage rolls equal to half your level (minimum 1)."}

::ab[Heart of Carnage (major)]{icon=boost-def flavor="You can touch an ally and bless it with even greater destructive power." l10="For 1 minute, the ally gains a +4 insight bonus on attack rolls made to confirm critical hits and has a 50% chance to treat any critical hit or ‹ability/sneak attack› against it as a normal hit."}

earth.name: Earth
description: ::ab[Acid Strike (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can touch one weapon and enhance it with acidic potency." l1="For 1 minute, this weapon emits acrid fumes that deal an additional 1d4 points of acid damage with each strike. This additional damage doesn't stack with the additional damage from the ‹magic-enh/corrosive› weapon special ability."}

::ab[Armor of Earth (major)]{icon=def l10="You can touch an ally and harden its armor or clothing. For 1 minute, the ally gains DR 1/-." incrementPlain="The ally's DR~10~2~2~1" incrementDesc="improves to~increases to" incrementEnd="/-." incrementMax=18 special="This doesn't stack with any other damage resistance."}

earthquake.name: Earthquake
description: @HL[Deities:] Evil deities that offer the ‹blessing/Earth› blessing or nonevil deities with disasters in their portfolios

::ab[Stone's Base (minor)]{icon=def flavor="You can touch an ally to bless it with the stalwart resilience of stone." l1="For 1 minute, the creature gains a +4 bonus to its CMD against maneuvers that would move the ally or knock it prone."}

::ab[Earth Hammer (major)]{icon=lower l10="You can touch a weapon to bless it with the force of a mighty earthquake for 1 minute. When the weapon hits a creature, the target must succeed at a Reflex save or fall ‹rule/prone›; either way, the creature is immune to this ability for 24 hours."}

evil.name: Evil
description: ::ab[Unholy Strike (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can touch one weapon and give it an evil blessing." l1="For 1 minute, this weapon takes on a black, orange, or violet cast and deals an additional 1d6 points of damage against good creatures. During this time, it's treated as evil for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. This additional damage doesn't stack with the additional damage from the ‹magic-enh/unholy› weapon special ability."}

::ab[Battle Companion (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can summon a battle companion. This ability functions as ‹spell/summon monster IV› with a duration of 1 minute, but for only an evil outsider or an animal with the ‹template/fiendish› creature simple template. This ability can summon only one creature, regardless of the list used." incrementRoman="This now behaves as ‹spell/summon~10~2~5" incrementDesc=monster incrementEnd="›."}

fire.name: Fire
description: ::ab[Fire Strike (minor)]{icon=boost  flavor="You can touch one weapon and enhance it with the grandeur of fire." l1="For 1 minute, this weapon glows red-hot and deals an additional 1d4 points of fire damage with each hit. This additional damage doesn't stack with the additional damage from the ‹magic-enh/flaming› or ‹magic-enh/flaming burst› weapon special abilities."}
::ab[Armor of Flame (major)]{icon=def l10="You can touch an ally to wreath it in flames. This works as ‹spell/fire shield› (warm shield only) with a duration of 1 minute."}

flood.name: Flood
description: @HL[Deities:] Evil deities that offer the ‹blessing/Water› blessing or nonevil deities with disasters in their portfolios

::ab[Lasting Breath (minor)]{icon=def flavor="You can touch an ally to bless it with an extra reserve of breath." l1="For 1 minute, while the ally ‹misc/hold«s» its breath›, standard and full-round actions don't decrease the number of rounds the ally can hold its breath."}

::ab[Tsunami Burst (major)]{icon=def l10="When you are hit by a melee attack, you can invoke this blessing as an @HLimmediate_action. A wave of water blasts out from you at your attacker, attempting a ‹rule/bull rush› combat maneuver check using your CMB but adding your Wisdom modifier instead of your Strength modifier."}

glory.name: Glory
description: ::ab[Glorious Presence (minor)]{icon=def flavor="You can touch an ally and grant it a glorious blessing." l1="For 1 minute, the ally becomes mesmerizing to her foes. This functions as ‹spell/sanctuary›, except if the ally attacks an opponent, this effect ends with respect to only that opponent. This is a mind-affecting effect."}

::ab[Demoralizing Glory (major)]{icon=lower l10="When you successfully damage an opponent with a melee attack or attack spell, as a @HLswift_action you can attempt to demoralize that opponent with the ‹skill/Intimidate› skill using your ranks in Intimidate or your warpriest level, whichever is higher."}

godclaw.name: Godclaw
description: ::ab[Command Obedience (minor)]{icon=def l1="You can touch an ally and say a quick word to remind her of her obligations, granting her a new saving throw against each enchantment effect that currently affects her. If the saving throw is successful, the enchantment effect immediately ends. This power affects only effects that allow a saving throw."}

::ab[Tactical Readiness (major)]{icon=power-def l10="You can rally your allies within 30 feet, allowing each to immediately do one of the following as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity: remove the ‹rule/flat-footed› condition, ‹rule/take a 5-foot step›, draw a weapon, ready a shield, or gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC for 1 round. You can affect a number of allies equal to your Wisdom bonus. These actions do not count against your allies' total movement or actions on their next turn."}

good.name: Good
description: ::ab[Holy Strike (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can touch one weapon and bless it with the power of purity and goodness." l1="For 1 minute, this weapon glows green, white, or yellow-gold and deals an additional 1d6 points of damage against evil creatures. During this time, it's treated as good for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. This additional damage doesn't stack with the additional damage from the ‹magic-enh/holy› weapon special ability."}

::ab[Battle Companion (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can summon a battle companion. This ability functions as ‹spell/summon monster IV› with a duration of 1 minute, but for only a good outsider or an animal with the ‹template/celestial› creature simple template. This ability can summon only one creature, regardless of the list used." incrementRoman="This now behaves as ‹spell/summon~10~2~5" incrementDesc=monster incrementEnd="›."}

healing.name: Healing
description: ::ab[Powerful Healer (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can add power to a ‹main/cure spell<s› as you cast it." l1="As a @HLswift_action, you can treat any *cure* spell as if it were empowered (as the ‹feat/Empower Spell› feat), causing it to heal 50% more damage (or deal 50% more damage if used against undead). This ability doesn't stack with itself or the Empower Spell feat."}
::ab[Fast Healing (major)]{icon=aid l10="You can touch an ally and grant it ‹umr/fast healing› 3 for 1 minute."}
@HL[ReplacementBlessing:] The following minor blessing replaces the *powerful healer* ability of the Healing blessing.

::ab[Ameliorating Touch (minor)]{icon=aid flavor="Your touch is a balm to your suffering allies." l1="You can touch an ally as a @HLswift_action to temporarily relieve that ally of the ‹misc/fatigued›, ‹misc/shaken›, or ‹misc/sickened› condition. This blessing suppresses those conditions for 1 minute." l2="You can spend two uses of your blessing ability whenever you heal yourself or an ally with your *fervor* class ability to use this minor blessing as a @HLfree_action instead of a swift action."}
@HL[ReplacementBlessing:] The following major blessing replaces the *fast healing* ability of the Healing blessing.

::ab[Return of the Fallen (major)]{icon=magic flavor="Your touch can defy the cold claws of death itself." l10="You can temporarily revive a touched ally to continue fighting, as if you had cast ‹spell/raise dead› on her. The revived ally is also ‹misc/staggered› for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your warpriest level, after which she immediately dies. The ally is free to act as she sees fit during this time, and you are granted no control over her."}

knowledge.name: Knowledge
description: ::ab[Lore Keeper (minor)]{icon=touch flavor="You can touch a creature to learn about its abilities and weaknesses." l1="With a successful touch attack, you gain information as if your result on the appropriate Knowledge skill check were equal to 15 + your warpriest level + your Wisdom modifier."}

::ab[Monster Lore (major)]{icon=boost-def l10="When you succeed at a Knowledge check against an opponent to learn about its abilities or weaknesses (or succeed at a touch attack using the *lore keeper* blessing, above), you can as a @HLswift_action gain a +2 insight bonus on attacks, saving throws, and ability and skill checks, as well as to your AC against that creature. This effect lasts for 1 minute."}

law.name: Law
description: ::ab[Axiomatic Strike (minor)]{icon=boost flavor="You can touch one weapon and enhance it with the essence of law." l1="For 1 minute, this weapon glows blue, pale yellow, or white and deals an additional 1d6 points of damage against chaotic creatures. During this time, it's treated as lawful for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. This additional damage doesn't stack with the additional damage from the ‹magic-enh/axiomatic› weapon special ability."}

::ab[Battle Companion (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can summon a battle companion. This ability functions as ‹spell/summon monster IV› with a duration of 1 minute, but for only a lawful outsider or an animal with the ‹template/resolute› creature simple template. This ability can summon only one creature, regardless of the list used." incrementRoman="This now behaves as ‹spell/summon~10~2~5" incrementDesc=monster incrementEnd="›."}

liberation.name: Liberation
description: ::ab[Liberation (minor)]{icon=magic l1="For 1 round as a @HLswift_action, you can ignore impediments to your mobility and effects that cause ‹rule/paralysis› (as ‹spell/freedom of movement›). You can activate this blessing even if you're otherwise unable to take actions, but not if you're unconscious."}

::ab[Freedom's Shout (major)]{icon=aura-magic l10="As a @HLswift_action you can emit a 30-foot aura that affects all allies with the *liberation* blessing described above. This effect lasts for 1 round."}
@HL[ReplacementBlessing:] The following major blessing replaces the *freedom's shout* ability of the Liberation blessing.
::ab[Greater Liberation (major)]{icon=boost l10="When you use the *liberation* ability of the Liberation blessing, its effects last for 1 minute."}

luck.name: Luck
description: ::ab[Lucky Presence (minor)]{icon=roll flavor="You can touch an ally and grant it a lucky presence." l1="The target of this luck can call upon it to roll any one ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check twice and take the better result. The decision to use this ability must be made before the roll is made. Once used, or once 1 minute passes, the effect ends."}

::ab[Unlucky Enemy (major)]{icon=roll l10="As an @HLimmediate_action you can force an adjacent opponent to reroll an attack, saving throw, or skill or ability check it just attempted; it must take the lower of the two rolls. You must declare this after the roll is made but before the result is revealed."}

madness.name: Madness
description: ::ab[Madness Supremacy (minor)]{icon=aid l1="As a @HLswift_action you can target a creature within 30 feet that has the ‹misc/cowering›, ‹misc/frightened›, ‹misc/panicked›, or ‹rule/paralyzed› condition. That condition is suspended for 1 round, and the chosen creature gains the ‹misc/confused› condition instead. The confused creature rerolls any result other than &quot&attack self&quot& or &quot&attack nearest creature.&quot& The round spent confused counts toward the duration of the suspended effect. At the end of the confused round, the suspended condition resumes."}

::ab[Control Madness (major)]{icon=power l10="As a @HLswift_action you can choose one behavior for all confused creatures within 30 feet to exhibit (as if all creatures rolled the same result). This effect lasts for 1 round. You can use this ability even while you are confused."}

magic.name: Magic
description: ::ab[Hand of the Acolyte (minor)]{icon=ranged l1="You can cause your melee weapon to fly from your grasp and strike an opponent, then instantly return to you. You can make a single attack using a melee weapon at a range of 30 feet. This attack is treated as a ranged attack with a thrown weapon, except that you add your Wisdom modifier to the attack roll instead of your Dexterity modifier (you still add your Strength modifier to the damage roll as normal). This ability cannot be used to perform a combat maneuver."}

::ab[Blessed Magic (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can cast a prepared warpriest spell without expending its spell slot. The spell must have a casting time of 1 standard action and must use a spell slot that is at least 3 spell levels lower than the highest warpriest spell level you can cast. In addition, the spell must be one that damages a creature or causes a creature to take penalties (such as ‹spell/inflict light wounds› or ‹spell/bane›). For example, if you are 10th level and can cast 4th-level warpriest spells, you could use this blessing to cast a 1st-level warpriest spell without expending its spell slot."}

nobility.name: Nobility
description: ::ab[Inspiring Word (minor)]{icon=boost-def l1="You can speak a few words to a creature within 30 feet that fill them with inspiration. You can grant that creature a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, or saving throws (your choice). This effect lasts for 1 minute."}

::ab[Lead by Example (major)]{icon=boost l10="As a @HLswift_action you can inspire your allies to follow your lead. If the following action on your turn is an attack or skill check, all allies within 30 feet who take the same action against the same foe or obstacle on their next turn gain a +4 morale bonus on that roll."}
@HL[ReplacementBlessing:] The following major blessing replaces the *lead by example* ability of the Nobility blessing.

::ab[Martyr's Sacrifice (major)]{icon=protect flavor="Your body can accept wounds meant for others you deem worthy." l10="You can shoulder the wounds of an ally within 50 feet for 1 minute, and during this time, the ally is affected as if you had cast ‹spell/shield other› on her (except with a range of 50 feet)." special="You can have only one use of this ability active at a time; if you use this major blessing again, the previous use immediately expires."}

plant.name: Plant
description: ::ab[Creeping Vines (minor)]{icon=lower l1="Upon hitting with a melee attack, as a @HLswift_action you cause the creature you hit to sprout entangling vines that attempt to hold it in place, ‹rule/entangl«ing<ed› it for 1 round (Reflex negates)."}

::ab[Battle Companion (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can summon a battle companion. This ability functions as ‹spell/summon nature's ally IV›, with a duration of 1 minute. This ability can summon only one animal, regardless of the list used, and the creature's type changes to ‹type/plant› instead of animal." incrementRoman="This now behaves as ‹spell/summon nature's~10~2~5" incrementDesc=ally incrementEnd="›."}

protection.name: Protection
description: ::ab[Increased Defense (minor)]{icon=def l1="You can gain a +1 sacred bonus on saving throws and a +1 sacred bonus to AC for 1 minute." increment="The bonus~0~10"}

::ab[Aura of Protection (major)]{icon=aura-def-protect l10="You can emit a 30-foot aura of protection for 1 minute. You and your allies within this aura gain ‹umr/resistance› 10 against acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic." l15="The energy resistance increases to 20."}

repose.name: Repose
description: ::ab[Gentle Rest (minor)]{icon=touch l1="You can fill a living creature with lethargy by hitting it with a melee touch attack, causing it to become ‹misc/staggered› for 1 round. If the target is already staggered, it falls asleep for 1 round instead. An undead creature that's touched is staggered for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1)."}

::ab[Back to the Grave (major)]{icon=aura l10="When using ‹ability/channel energy› to heal living creatures, you can take a @HLswift_action on that same turn to also deal damage to undead creatures (as your *channel energy* ability). Undead take an amount of damage equal to half the amount healed, and can attempt the normal saving throw to halve this damage."}

rune.name: Rune
description: ::ab[Blast Rune (minor)]{icon=magic l1="You can create a blast rune in any adjacent square. Any creature entering this square takes an amount of damage equal to 1d6 + 1/2 your warpriest level. This rune deals either acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage, designated when you create the rune.~~~The rune is invisible, and lasts a number of rounds equal to your warpriest level or until discharged. You cannot create a blast rune in a square occupied by another creature. This rune counts as a 1st-level spell for the purposes of dispelling. It can be discovered with a successful DC 26 Perception skill check and disarmed with a successful DC 26 Disable Device skill check."}

::ab[Spell-Storing Weapon (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can cast a spell into a magic weapon as if it had the ‹magic-enh/spell storing› weapon special ability. If the stored spell is not used within 10 minutes, it dissipates."}

scalykind.name: Scalykind
description: ::ab[Scaly Touch (minor)]{icon=def l1="You can touch an ally as a @HLstandard_action to grant it reptilian scales. For 1 minute, the ally gains an enhancement bonus to its natural armor equal to 1 + ‹misc/one-fifth› of your warpriest level."}

As a @HLstandard_action you can manifest venomous fangs for 1 minute. These fangs grant a ‹umr/bite attack› that deals 1d4 points of damage (for a Medium warpriest, 1d3 if Small). A successful bite also afflicts the opponent with a debilitating venom.
::aff[Serpent Venom]{iconP type=Bite-injury dcF dcYou dcLev=warpriest dcMod=Con freqR=4 effCon="1d2" cure1}

shadow.name: Shadow
description: ::ab[Flicker of Shadows (minor)]{icon=boost l1="You can cause a weapon you touch to warp and become insubstantial for a split second before an attack. The first attack made with this weapon each round ignores any shield bonus to Armor Class, as well as bonuses from ‹rule/cover›. Total cover still provides a creature its full benefit. This effect lasts for 1 minute."}

::ab[Swift as Shadow (major)]{icon=boost l10="You can spend a @HLswift_action to empower yourself or an ally within 30 feet to move over the ground as easily as its shadow. The subject's land speed increases by 10 feet and it takes no movement penalties for darkness, difficult terrain, or slickness. The creature can safely move over areas of ice and even those affected by a ‹spell/grease› spell.~~~When a creature affected by this ability hits with a ‹rule/charge› attack, that attack deals an amount of additional cold damage equal to your level."}

strength.name: Strength
description: ::ab[Strength Surge (minor)]{icon=boost l1="As a @HLswift_action you can focus your own strength. You gain an enhancement bonus equal to 1/2 your warpriest level (minimum +1) on melee attack rolls, combat maneuver checks that rely on Strength, Strength-based skills, and Strength checks for 1 round."}

::ab[Strength of Will (major)]{icon=boost-def l10="As a @HLswift_action you can ignore the movement penalties caused by wearing medium or heavy armor or by carrying a medium or heavy load. This effect lasts for 1 minute. During this time, you can add your Strength modifier on saving throws against effects that would cause you to become ‹rule/entangled›, ‹misc/staggered›, or ‹rule/paralyzed›."}

sun.name: Sun
description: ::ab[Blinding Strike (minor)]{icon=lower l1="You can create a flash of sunlight in the eyes of one of your opponents. The target is ‹misc/blinded› for 1 round. If it succeeds at a Reflex saving throw, it's instead ‹misc/dazzled› for 1 round. Creatures with ‹umr/light blindness› or ‹umr/light sensitivity› take a -4 penalty on this saving throw." special="This is a ‹spelldef/light› effect. Sightless creatures are unaffected by this ability."}

::ab[Cleansing Fire (major)]{icon=boost l10="You can touch a weapon and grant it either the ‹magic-enh/flaming› or undead-‹magic-enh/bane› weapon special ability for 1 minute. If you spend two uses of your *blessing* when activating this ability, the weapon can have both weapon special abilities."}

tornado.name: Tornado
description: @HL[Deities:] Evil deities that offer the ‹blessing/Air› blessing or nonevil deities with disasters in their portfolios

::ab[Dust Devil (minor)]{icon=lower l1="When you hit with a weapon attack, you can use a @HLswift_action to cause a sudden burst of wind and debris to swirl around your target. The target is ‹misc/dazzled› for 1 minute."}

::ab[Howling Gale (major)]{icon=aura l10="You can invoke a howling windstorm around yourself as a @HLstandard_action. For 1 minute, any Large or smaller creature takes twice as much movement to enter a space adjacent to you due to the winds, and thus can't ‹rule/take a 5-foot step› to move adjacent to you."}

travel.name: Travel
description: ::ab[Agile Feet (minor)]{icon=boost l1="As a @HLswift_action you gain increased mobility. For 1 round, you ignore all ‹rule/difficult terrain› (including magical terrain) and take no penalties for moving through it."}

::ab[Dimensional Hop (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can teleport up to 20 feet as a @HLmove_action. You can increase this distance by expending another use of your *blessing* - each use spent grants an additional 20 feet. You must have line of sight to your destination. This teleportation doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity." special="You can bring other willing creatures with you, but each such creature requires expending one additional use of your *blessing,* regardless of the distance traveled. (For example, transporting yourself 40 feet costs 2 uses of your *blessing,* and transporting an additional person this distance costs 1 more use.)"}

trickery.name: Trickery
description: ::ab[Double (minor)]{icon=def l1="As a @HLmove_action you can create an illusory double of yourself. This double functions as a single ‹spell/mirror image›, and lasts for a number of rounds equal to your warpriest level, or until the illusory duplicate is ‹spell/dispel«led› or destroyed." special="You can have no more than one double at a time. The double created by this ability doesn't stack with the additional images from the mirror image spell."}
::ab[Greater Invisibility (major)]{icon=magic l10="As a @HLswift_action you can become invisible for 1 round (as ‹spell/greater invisibility›)."}

void.name: Void
description: ::ab[Airless Touch (minor)]{icon=touch-lower l1="With a successful melee touch attack you can steal the breath from an opponent's lungs, leaving it unable to speak, use breath weapons, cast spells with verbal components, or do anything else requiring breath for 1 round. If the target fails at a Fortitude saving throw, it's also ‹misc/staggered› for 1 round as it catches its breath. If the target was attempting to ‹misc/hold its breath›, it can no longer do so: it must breathe on its turn or risk ‹rule/suffocation› and unconsciousness." special="Creatures that don't need to breathe are unaffected. Regardless of whether it succeeds at its saving throw, the target is immune to further uses of your *airless touch* for 24 hours."}

::ab[Deny Gravity (major)]{icon=boost l10="As a @HLstandard_action you can touch an ally to allow her to ignore the effects of gravity for 1 minute (as ‹spell/fly›). The ally gains a fly speed of 40 feet with average maneuverability. The ally is also immune to dangerous environmental conditions (as ‹spell/life bubble›) for 1 minute."}

war.name: War
description: ::ab[War Mind (minor)]{icon=boost-def l1="You can touch an ally and grant it a tactical advantage for 1 minute. At the start of its turn each round, it can select one of the following bonuses: +10 feet to base land speed, +1 dodge bonus to AC, +1 insight bonus on attack rolls, or a +1 luck bonus on saving throws. Each bonus selected lasts for 1 round."}

::ab[Battle Lust (major)]{icon=boost l10="You can touch an ally and grant it a thirst for battle.``All of the ally's melee attacks are treated as if they had the ‹magic-enh/vicious› weapon special ability, but the additional damage dealt to the ally from that special ability is nonlethal. In addition, the ally receives a +4 insight bonus on attack rolls made to confirm critical hits. These benefits last for 1 minute."}

water.name: Water
description: ::ab[Ice Strike (minor)]{icon=boost l1="You can touch one weapon and enhance it with the power of water.``For 1 minute, this weapon glows with a blue-white chill and deals an additional 1d4 points of cold damage with each strike. This additional damage doesn't stack with the additional damage from the ‹magic-enh/frost› or ‹magic-enh/icy burst› weapon special abilities."}
::ab[Armor of Ice (major)]{icon=protect l10="You can touch any one ally and wreath it in freezing mist. This works as ‹spell/fire shield› (chill shield only) with a duration 1 minute."}

weather.name: Weather
description: ::ab[Storm Strike (minor)]{icon=boost l1="You can touch one weapon and grant it a blessing of stormy weather.``For 1 minute, this weapon glows with blue or yellow sparks and deals an additional 1d4 points of electricity damage with each hit. This additional damage doesn't stack with the additional damage from the ‹magic-enh/shock› or ‹magic-enh/shocking burst› weapon special abilities."}

::ab[Wind Barrier (major)]{icon=magic l10="You can create a barrier of fast winds around yourself for 1 minute. This acts as a ‹spell/wind wall› on all sides of your square, protects you with ‹spell/feather fall›, and doesn't interfere with your ranged attacks."}

wildfire.name: Wildfire
description: @HL[Deities:] Evil deities that offer the ‹blessing/Fire› blessing or nonevil deities with disasters in their portfolios

::ab[Leaping Flames (minor)]{icon=boost-def l1="You touch an ally to bless it with the speed of a wildfire for 1 minute. The ally gains a +10-foot enhancement bonus to its base speed, and the ally gains a +1 dodge bonus to its AC against attacks of opportunity."}

::ab[Fiery Wake (major)]{icon=magic l10="When you move, you can use a @HLswift_action to invoke a blazing blessing on yourself. For the rest of your turn, your movement leaves behind a 10-foot-tall wall of opaque fire in your path. The wall burns for 1 minute. A creature that touches the wall takes 2d6 points of fire damage."}
